[07] How the Growth System applies

Answer every peak call. Spend only when there are hours to sell.

At the peaks we protect the phone: overflow answering, call-backs in minutes and no wasted ad spend. In the shoulders we turn demand back on.

  • IF BOOKED OVER 90%

    Pause demand ads, keep brand search on, route overflow calls and book maintenance for later weeks.

  • IF BOOKED 70–90%

  • IF BOOKED UNDER 70%

    Turn on tune-up, plan and replacement campaigns; call members who are due.
